pairs.target: dìèrtiān de kèzhuō shàng méiyǒu túzhǐ , zhǐyǒu sāngēn gāngtiáo hé yíjià xiǎo chèng .
pairs.english: Next day's desk held no drawings, only three steel strips and a small balance.
pairs.hanzi: 第二天的课桌上没有图纸，只有三根钢条和一架小秤。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zuòxià shí , mǐlā yǐjīng bǎ xiùkǒu wǎn hǎo , zhèng shēn zhǐtou qù bō chèngpán , bèi duìmiàn de shàonián yòng chǐzi dǎng le yíxià .
pairs.english: As Tavi sat down, Mira had rolled her cuffs and was reaching to flick a balance pan, but the boy opposite blocked her with a ruler.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维坐下时，米拉已经把袖口挽好，正伸指头去拨秤盘，被对面的少年用尺子挡了一下。

pairs.target: " hái méi tiáo píng . "
pairs.english: “Not leveled yet.”
pairs.hanzi: “还没调平。”

pairs.target: shàonián jiào luò héng , qiánjǐcì kè zǒng zuòzài chuāng biān .
pairs.english: The boy was Lohen, who'd sat by the window in earlier lessons.
pairs.hanzi: 少年叫洛衡，前几次课总坐在窗边。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jìde tā de zhǐ , zì xiǎo , jiānjù què hěn qí , túdiào de dìfāng yě dōu yòng yídào zhíxiàn huáguò .
pairs.english: Tavi remembered his papers: small writing, even spacing, mistakes crossed out with a single straight line.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维记得他的纸，字小，间距却很齐，涂掉的地方也都用一道直线划过。

pairs.target: tā jīntiān huàn dào zhè zhāng zhuō , yīnwèi yuánlái nà zhāng de jiá zuò sōng le .
pairs.english: He'd changed tables today because his old table's clamp had loosened.
pairs.hanzi: 他今天换到这张桌，因为原来那张的夹座松了。

pairs.target: mǐlā shōuhuí shǒu , méiyǒu dàoqiàn , zhuǎntóu wèn tǎ wéi dài méi dài zuótiān de cǎotú .
pairs.english: Mira withdrew her hand without apologizing and turned to ask whether Tavi had yesterday's sketch.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉收回手，没有道歉，转头问塔维带没带昨天的草图。

pairs.target: tā shuō zài qǐn fáng , tā tàn le yìshēng , cóng zìjǐ nà dié zhǐ lǐ chōuchū yìzhāng kòngbái de .
pairs.english: He said it was in his room. She sighed and drew a blank sheet from her own stack.
pairs.hanzi: 他说在寝房，她叹了一声，从自己那叠纸里抽出一张空白的。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī zǒu dào zhuōbiān , bǎ sāngēn gāngtiáo fēnkāi .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey came to the table and separated the three strips.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师走到桌边，把三根钢条分开。

pairs.target: liǎnggēn yíyàng cháng , dìsāngēn duǎn yìxiē , què hòu dé duō .
pairs.english: Two were equally long; the third was shorter but much thicker.
pairs.hanzi: 两根一样长，第三根短一些，却厚得多。

pairs.target: tā ràng tāmen xiān xuǎn yíduì , xiěxià lǐyóu , zài guà xiǎo fǎmǎ kàn biànhuà .
pairs.english: She told them to choose a pair, write their reasons, then hang small weights to observe changes.
pairs.hanzi: 她让他们先选一对，写下理由，再挂小砝码看变化。

pairs.target: " biéjí zhe lián . xiān rèn dōngxī . "
pairs.english: “Don't rush to link them. Know your materials first.”
pairs.hanzi: “别急着连。先认东西。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xuǎn le liǎnggēn cháng de . tāmen bìng páifàng zhe , kuāndù yě xiāngjìn , mōshàngqù què yǒu xìxiǎo de chābié .
pairs.english: Tavi chose the long pair. Side by side, they were similar in width, yet felt subtly different.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维选了两根长的。它们并排放着，宽度也相近，摸上去却有细小的差别。

pairs.target: tā fānguò yìgēn , fāxiàn bèimiàn mó guò , biānyuán bǐ lìng yìgēn báo .
pairs.english: He turned one over and found its back ground down, the edge thinner than the other's.
pairs.hanzi: 他翻过一根，发现背面磨过，边缘比另一根薄。

pairs.target: tā hái méi huàn , luò héng yǐjīng bǎ nàgēn báo de tuī dào yìpáng .
pairs.english: Before he changed his choice, Lohen pushed the thin one aside.
pairs.hanzi: 他还没换，洛衡已经把那根薄的推到一旁。

pairs.target: " duǎn de gēn hòu de nàgēn . " " tāmen yíyàng zhòng ? " mǐlā wèn . " chàbùduō . xiān liáng . "
pairs.english: “The short one and the thicker one.” “Same weight?” Mira asked. “Nearly. Measure first.”
pairs.hanzi:
“短的跟厚的那根。”
“它们一样重？”米拉问。
“差不多。先量。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ yuánxiān xiě de yíduì huàdiào , xīnlǐ yǒuxiē bù shūfú .
pairs.english: Tavi crossed out his original pair, feeling uneasy.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把原先写的一对划掉，心里有些不舒服。

pairs.target: tā míngmíng yǐjīng mōchūlái le , què méi láidejí shuō .
pairs.english: He'd already felt the difference, but hadn't had time to say so.
pairs.hanzi: 他明明已经摸出来了，却没来得及说。

pairs.target: luò héng dītóu bǎi chèng , sìhū lián tā huà zhǐ de shēngyīn yě méiyǒu tīngjiàn .
pairs.english: Lohen bent over the balance, seeming not even to hear his pencil crossing the paper.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡低头摆秤，似乎连他划纸的声音也没有听见。

pairs.target: chēng wán yǐhòu , mǐlā yòu ná chǐ liáng chángkuān , luò héng bàoshù , tā jì .
pairs.english: After weighing, Mira measured length and width with the ruler; Lohen called numbers and she recorded them.
pairs.hanzi: 称完以后，米拉又拿尺量长宽，洛衡报数，她记。

pairs.target: sāngè rén suàn dé hěn màn , tǎ wéi gēnzhe kàn , fāxiàn nàgēn duǎn tiáo shǎodiào de chángdù , bèi hòudù bǔ le huílái .
pairs.english: The three calculated slowly. Following along, Tavi saw how thickness made up for the shorter strip's missing length.
pairs.hanzi: 三个人算得很慢，塔维跟着看，发现那根短条少掉的长度，被厚度补了回来。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī méiyǒu bǎ chèng shōuzǒu , zhī zài tāmen suàn chū de liǎnggè shùxià gè diǎn le yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey left the balance there and dotted beneath each of their two results.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师没有把秤收走，只在他们算出的两个数下各点了一点。

pairs.target: " zhè zǔ cáiliào xiāngjìn , cái ná zhòngliàng bāng nǐmen héduì . huàn le cáiliào , bùnéng zhī rèn chèng . "
pairs.english: “These materials are similar, so weight helps you check. With different materials, don't rely on the balance alone.”
pairs.hanzi: “这组材料相近，才拿重量帮你们核对。换了材料，不能只认秤。”

pairs.target: zhuāngjìn jiá zuò hòu , liǎnggēn gāngtiáo de zìyóu duān gè guà yìzhī tóngyàng de xiǎo fǎmǎ , hòumiàn lì zhe kèxiàn bǎn .
pairs.english: Clamped in place, each strip carried an identical small weight on its free end, with a marked board behind it.
pairs.hanzi: 装进夹座后，两根钢条的自由端各挂一只同样的小砝码，后面立着刻线板。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànqīng le duǎn tiáo xiàmiàn de kòngxì , cái bǎ liǎngzhīshǒu fēnbié tiē dào gāngtiáo gēnbù .
pairs.english: Tavi checked the gap under the short strip, then placed a hand against each strip near its base.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看清了短条下面的空隙，才把两只手分别贴到钢条根部。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu lìkè shǐ lì . zuǒbiān xiàng yíshàn hěn qīng de mén , yòubiān què xiàng mén hòu dǐng zhe dōngxī .
pairs.english: He didn't push immediately. The left felt like a light door, the right like one with something braced behind it.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有立刻使力。左边像一扇很轻的门，右边却像门后顶着东西。

pairs.target: tā xiàyìshí xiǎng duō tuī yìdiǎn , yúguānglǐ luò héng yǐjīng bǎ bǐjiān tíng zài zhǐ shàng , děng zhe jì .
pairs.english: Instinctively he wanted to push more. At the edge of his vision, Lohen held his pencil over the paper, waiting to record.
pairs.hanzi: 他下意识想多推一点，余光里洛衡已经把笔尖停在纸上，等着记。

pairs.target: zhè ràng tā gèng xiǎng zuò chūlái .
pairs.english: That made him want to succeed even more.
pairs.hanzi: 这让他更想做出来。

pairs.target: chángtiáo xiàngxià dòng le yìxiǎo gé , duǎn tiáo nà tóu jīhū kànbújiàn biànhuà .
pairs.english: The long strip moved down one small division; the short strip barely seemed to change.
pairs.hanzi: 长条向下动了一小格，短条那头几乎看不见变化。

pairs.target: tā sōngshǒu , děng kèxiàn bǎn qián de yǐngzi tíng wěn , cái chōuhuí shǒuzhǐ .
pairs.english: He released the link, waited for the shadows before the marked board to settle, then withdrew his fingers.
pairs.hanzi: 他松手，等刻线板前的影子停稳，才抽回手指。

pairs.target: " duǎn de méi dòng . " mǐlā shuō . " dòng le . " tǎ wéi shuō .
pairs.english: “The short one didn't move,” Mira said. “It did,” Tavi said.
pairs.hanzi:
“短的没动。”米拉说。
“动了。”塔维说。

pairs.target: luò héng méi táitóu : " wǒ zhèlǐ jì de shì kànbùqīng . "
pairs.english: Without looking up, Lohen said, “I'm recording ‘unclear.’”
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡没抬头：“我这里记的是看不清。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎng zhēng , yòu kàn le yìyǎn duǎn tiáo .
pairs.english: Tavi wanted to argue, then looked at the short strip again.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想争，又看了一眼短条。

pairs.target: fǎmǎ de shéngzi hái zài qīngqīng yáo , yǐngzi bǐ gāngtiáo běnshēn cū , shuí yě bùnéng ná yǐngzi dāng zhǔn shù .
pairs.english: The weight's cord still swayed gently. Its shadow was broader than the strip itself; nobody could use it for an exact reading.
pairs.hanzi: 砝码的绳子还在轻轻摇，影子比钢条本身粗，谁也不能拿影子当准数。

pairs.target: tā bǎ zìjǐ de nà yì gé cādiào , gǎichéng yígè wènhào . tā bù xǐhuan luò héng , dàn zhècì méi zài shuōhuà .
pairs.english: He erased his one division and replaced it with a question mark. He didn't like Lohen, but said nothing more this time.
pairs.hanzi:
他把自己的那一格擦掉，改成一个问号。
他不喜欢洛衡，但这次没再说话。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī ràng tāmen huànrén , xiān xiēshǒu .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey had them change operators and rest their hands.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师让他们换人，先歇手。

pairs.target: luò héng bìng méiyǒu bǐ tā nòng chū gèng dà de biànhuà , zhī bǎ kèxiàn bǎn nuó jìn , chóngxīn duì hǎo shìxiàn , zài zuòxià lái děng shéngzi bú huàng .
pairs.english: Lohen produced no bigger change. He merely brought the marked board closer, realigned his view, and sat waiting for the cord to stop swaying.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡并没有比他弄出更大的变化，只把刻线板挪近，重新对好视线，再坐下来等绳子不晃。

pairs.target: tā zuò de shíhòu , mǐlā dūn dào le duǎn tiáo pángbiān .
pairs.english: As he worked, Mira crouched beside the short strip.
pairs.hanzi: 他做的时候，米拉蹲到了短条旁边。

pairs.target: " zhèhuí kànjiàn le . " tā shuō , " wǎng shàng . "
pairs.english: “I see it this time,” she said. “Upward.”
pairs.hanzi: “这回看见了。”她说，“往上。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yě kànjiàn le . chángtiáo wǎng xià , duǎn tiáo wǎng shàng , dōu zhǐyǒu yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: Tavi saw it too. The long strip down, the short one up, each just a little.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维也看见了。长条往下，短条往上，都只有一点。

pairs.target: luò héng sōngshǒu , liǎngbiān mànmàn huídào yuánlái de wèizhì .
pairs.english: Lohen released, and both slowly returned to their starting positions.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡松手，两边慢慢回到原来的位置。

pairs.target: tā zài zhǐ shàng jìxià liǎngdào jiàntóu , suíhòu cái táitóu wèn mǐlā , gāngcái yǒuméiyǒu dǎngzhù tā .
pairs.english: He drew two arrows, then looked up to ask Mira whether he'd blocked her view.
pairs.hanzi: 他在纸上记下两道箭头，随后才抬头问米拉，刚才有没有挡住她。

pairs.target: " dǎng le bànbiān . " tā bǎ yǐzi wǎnghòu nuó , tuǐ zhuàng zài tǎ wéi xīgài shàng , gǎnjǐn shuō le shēng duìbùqǐ .
pairs.english: “Half of it.” He shifted his chair back, knocked Tavi's knee with its leg, and quickly apologized.
pairs.hanzi:
“挡了半边。”
他把椅子往后挪，腿撞在塔维膝盖上，赶紧说了声对不起。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yáotóu , fǎndǎo bù zhīdào gāi bǎ nà diǎn tǎoyàn fàngzài nǎlǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi shook his head, no longer knowing where to put his dislike.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维摇头，反倒不知道该把那点讨厌放在哪里。

pairs.target: xiūxi yǐhòu , tǎ wéi yòu shì le yìhuí . mǐlā fùzé kàn duǎn tiáo , luò héng kàn chángtiáo .
pairs.english: After a rest Tavi tried again, Mira watching the short strip and Lohen the long one.
pairs.hanzi: 休息以后，塔维又试了一回。米拉负责看短条，洛衡看长条。

pairs.target: tā zhècì bù zhuī zuǒshǒu nà diǎn róngyì de gǎnjué , děng liǎngbiān dōu zài xīnlǐ zhànwěn , cái qīngqīng wǎngqián sòng .
pairs.english: This time he didn't chase the easy feeling on the left; he let both sides settle in his mind, then eased forward.
pairs.hanzi: 他这次不追左手那点容易的感觉，等两边都在心里站稳，才轻轻往前送。

pairs.target: liǎnggè shēngyīn jīhū tóngshí xiǎng qǐlái : " dòng le . "
pairs.english: Two voices sounded almost together: “It moved.”
pairs.hanzi: 两个声音几乎同时响起来：“动了。”

pairs.target: tā mǎshàng sōngkāi , shǒuzhǐ hái néng qīngchǔ dì mō dào zhuōbiān de yíchù mù cì .
pairs.english: He released at once, his fingers still clearly able to feel a splinter at the table edge.
pairs.hanzi: 他马上松开，手指还能清楚地摸到桌边的一处木刺。

pairs.target: mǐlā bǎ jiàntóu huà gěi tā kàn , luò héng bǔ shàng fǎmǎ de zhòngliàng , shuí yě méi tì shuí gǎi zì .
pairs.english: Mira showed him her arrows. Lohen added the weights used; neither altered the other's writing.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉把箭头画给他看，洛衡补上砝码的重量，谁也没替谁改字。

pairs.target: kuài xiàkèshí , wéi lǎoshī bǎ yìzhī xiǎo líng fàngdào zhuōshàng , ràng tāmen chuán zhe kàn .
pairs.english: Near the end of class, Instructor Vey set a little bell on the table for them to pass around.
pairs.hanzi: 快下课时，维老师把一只小铃放到桌上，让他们传着看。

pairs.target: dìshíwǔtiān , měizǔ sāngè rén , yào yòng liǎnggēn pèi hǎo de gāngtiáo zuò yígè néng huàn xiǎng de zhuāngzhì :
pairs.english: On day fifteen, teams of three would use two matched strips to make a device that switched which bell rang:
pairs.hanzi: 第十五天，每组三个人，要用两根配好的钢条做一个能换响的装置：

pairs.target: yìbiān xiǎng shí lìngyìbiān bù xiǎng , sōngshǒu hòu huídào yuányàng .
pairs.english: One ringing while the other stayed silent, returning to its original state on release.
pairs.hanzi: 一边响时另一边不响，松手后回到原样。

pairs.target: yòng xiànchéng jiá zuò , xiǎo fǎmǎ , xiān huàtú , zhuāng hǎo yóu tā jiǎnchá , bùnéng náshǒu qù bāi líng piàn màochōng jiè xìng .
pairs.english: They would use ready-made clamps and small weights, draw plans first, then have her check the assembly; bending the bell pieces by hand wouldn't count as property borrowing.
pairs.hanzi: 用现成夹座，小砝码，先画图，装好由她检查，不能拿手去掰铃片冒充借性。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi hái méi fàngxià líng , mǐlā yǐjīng názǒu tā zhuōshàng de kōng zhǐ .
pairs.english: Before Tavi put down the bell, Mira had taken the blank paper from his desk.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维还没放下铃，米拉已经拿走他桌上的空纸。

pairs.target: " nǐ , wǒ , zài zhǎo shuí ? " tā cháo ménkǒu kàn .
pairs.english: “You, me, and who else?” He looked toward the door.
pairs.hanzi:
“你，我，再找谁？”
他朝门口看。

pairs.target: yīwén zhèng ná zhe zìjǐ de jìlù guòlái , zhǐ shàng yǒu yíkuài xīnxiān de mò wū .
pairs.english: Iven was coming over with his own notes, a fresh ink blot on the paper.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文正拿着自己的记录过来，纸上有一块新鲜的墨污。

pairs.target: " wǒ tīngjiàn le . " yīwén shuō , " wǒ hái méi dāying . " mǐlā bǎ dìsānzhāng yǐzi tīchūlái . tā zuòxià le .
pairs.english: “I heard,” Iven said. “I haven't agreed yet.” Mira kicked out the third chair. He sat down.
pairs.hanzi:
“我听见了。”伊文说，“我还没答应。”
米拉把第三张椅子踢出来。他坐下了。
